name: Is it better to build an exterior addition or convert basement space into a bedroom?

mainEntity.name: Is it better to build an exterior addition or convert basement space into a bedroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Converting an existing basement or attic into a bedroom is generally faster and less disruptive to your lot than building a ground-up addition. An interior conversion uses your existing roof and foundation, avoiding excavation, concrete footing pours, and exterior siding tie-ins. However, interior spaces must meet strict legal requirements, including ceiling height minimums and digging an egress window well in basements. A ground-up addition provides full control over room dimensions and ceiling heights, but it involves higher material costs and site disruption.
acceptedAnswer.description: Basement conversions use existing structural shells and cost less, but ground-up additions provide complete control over dimensions, light, and main-floor accessibility.
